purpose: Generic (family-agnostic) statistical/utility toolkit for the 6-family Task 67A phenomenon discovery screen, so each family's Stage 1 script does not re-implement bootstrap/concentration/dedup/matching/MFE-MAE/forward-return logic from scratch.

module.no_init_py: Deliberate: this repo uses implicit PEP 420 namespace packages everywhere (research/, research/scripts/, talonx_quant/, etc. all lack __init__.py). research/task67a_lib/ follows the same convention.

functions_borrowed_from: bootstrap_descriptive (percentile bootstrap, seeded np.random.default_rng, 95% quantile CI over resampled means)
matched_control (coarse-stratum common support + greedy bounded nearest-time one-to-one pairing)
excursion_and_forward (MFE/MAE reconstruction from raw OHLC bars between entry/exit; HORIZONS forward-excursion loop bounded by session close)

written_fresh_no_prior_hand_rolled_equiv: cross_family_overlap (same-symbol-time / same-symbol-day overlap between two event sets)
provenance.note: Checked (grep -i 'bootstrap|concentration|matched_control|dedup|clustering') across research/scripts/*.py before writing; only task55 and task58 had reusable logic, per the Task 67A briefing's own pointer.

functions.name: bootstrap_ci
functions.purpose: Percentile bootstrap CI for any statistic over an i.i.d.-resampled 1D sample.
functions.method: Draw n_resamples (default 10,000) bootstrap resamples with replacement (same size as input), compute `statistic` on each, take the [(1-ci_level)/2, 1-(1-ci_level)/2] quantiles as the CI. point_estimate is computed on the ORIGINAL sample, not the resample mean.
functions.determinism: seed: int (default DEFAULT_SEED=670067) -> fresh numpy.random.default_rng(seed) every call.
functions.small_n_honesty: n < min_n (default MIN_N_FOR_SUMMARY=5) -> insufficient_n=True, ci withheld (None), caveat explains why.

functions.name: bootstrap_ci_clustered
functions.purpose: Block/cluster bootstrap resampling whole GROUPS (e.g. symbol, or an event cluster from dedup_events) rather than individual rows, respecting within-group dependence.

functions.name: concentration_metrics
functions.purpose: top1/top3 symbol share, best-day share, best-period share of total POSITIVE value_col -- generalizes Task 58's winner-tail concentration and Task 55's top-winner-sensitivity checks.
functions.small_n_honesty: n_positive_rows < min_n (default 5) or total_positive<=0 -> insufficient_n=True, shares withheld.

functions.name: dedup_events
functions.purpose: Generic event clustering/de-duplication: within each group_keys group, merges runs of events whose consecutive time gap <= min_gap_minutes into one cluster; marks one representative row per cluster (first or last).

functions.name: matched_control_sample
functions.purpose: Generic two-group (treatment/control) matched-control sampling: coarse-stratum common support restricted to match_keys combinations present in BOTH groups, plus optional greedy bounded nearest-time one-to-one pairing.
functions.determinism: Algorithm itself is non-stochastic (greedy nearest-time assignment); seed accepted/stored for interface consistency with the rest of the module.

functions.name: effect_surface
functions.purpose: Broad-binned (default tertiles, NOT a fine grid -- deliberately coarse per the discovery plan's 'isolated optima are the strongest overfitting tell' guidance) parameter-stability surface: metric mean/median/std/n per bin combination.

functions.name: cross_family_overlap
functions.purpose: Same-symbol-time (within a tolerance) and same-symbol-day overlap between two families' event sets, reported directionally from both sides (a_covered_by_b and b_covered_by_a).

functions.name: compute_mfe_mae
functions.purpose: MFE/MAE from raw OHLC bars between entry/exit timestamps, long or short, matching Task 58's exact reconstruction definition (excursion boundary always includes entry price itself).

functions.name: forward_return_horizons
functions.purpose: Causal forward-looking return/excursion at a list of minute horizons (or None = to session close), bounded to never cross session close, matching Task 58's HORIZONS/forward_horizons_never_cross_session_close invariant.

seed_control_convention.rule: Every stochastic function takes an explicit seed: int kwarg defaulting to DEFAULT_SEED; internally builds numpy.random.default_rng(seed) fresh, never touches global numpy random state (np.random.seed is never called). Same seed + same input + same params => bit-identical output (verified by the determinism tests above running the same call twice and asserting equality).
seed_control_convention.caller_guidance: A Stage 1 script running several independent bootstraps (e.g. one per family) in the same process should pass distinct explicit seeds (e.g. DEFAULT_SEED + a per-family integer offset) so resamples are not accidentally correlated across families.

test_location: tests/test_task67a_research_stats.py (follows this repo's existing flat tests/test_taskNN_*.py convention -- confirmed via tests/ directory listing, no per-task subdirectory convention exists).

test_run_result.note: One bug was caught and fixed during this run: bootstrap_ci's vectorized fast path (np.mean/median/std/sum applied directly to the (n_resamples, n) resample matrix) was missing axis=1, which collapsed every resample to the identical scalar (ci_low==ci_high==point_estimate). Fixed by passing axis=1 explicitly; test_bootstrap_ci_contains_true_mean_on_symmetric_data (which failed under the bug) now passes.
